title.en: Unit 3: Choosing a Spouse and Emphasis

intro.en: A reading passage about marriage in Islam and how to choose a spouse. Read it slowly, sentence by sentence, then learn the new words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum shaadi aur biwi ke intikhaab ke baare mein ek parhne ka matn parhenge. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein, phir naye alfaaz seekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الزَّواجِ في الإِسْلامِ وَكَيْفِيَّةِ اخْتِيارِ الزَّوْجَةِ. اقْرَأْهُ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً بِبُطْءٍ، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةَ.

dialogue.ar: يَقِفُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الشَّبابِ حائِرينَ حينَ يُفَكِّرونَ في الزَّواجِ: كَيْفَ يَخْتارونَ الزَّوْجَةَ المُناسِبَةَ؟
dialogue.tr: yaqifu kathīrun mina sh-shabābi ḥāʾirīna ḥīna yufakkirūna fī z-zawāj: kayfa yakhtārūna z-zawjata l-munāsibat?
dialogue.en: Many young men stand puzzled when they think about marriage: how do they choose the suitable wife?
dialogue.ur: Bohat se naujawan shaadi ke baare mein sochte hue hairaan rehte hain: munasib biwi ka intikhaab kaise karein?

dialogue.ar: فَالزَّواجُ لَيْسَ حَفْلَةً تَنْتَهي في لَيْلَةٍ، بَلْ هُوَ رابِطَةٌ طَويلَةٌ تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الزَّوْجِ وَالزَّوْجَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-z-zawāju laysa ḥaflatan tantahī fī laylat, bal huwa rābiṭatun ṭawīlatun tajmaʿu bayna z-zawji wa z-zawjat.
dialogue.en: Marriage is not a party that ends in one night, but a long bond that joins the husband and the wife.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi aisi dawat nahi jo ek raat mein khatam ho jaye, balke ek lambi dori hai jo shauhar aur biwi ko jodti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَبِالزَّواجِ تَسْتَمِرُّ الحَياةُ وَتَنْشَأُ الذُّرِّيَّةُ الصّالِحَةُ في بَيْتٍ آمِن.
dialogue.tr: wa bilzzawāji tastamirru l-ḥayātu wa tanshaʾu dh-dhurriyyatu ṣ-ṣāliḥatu fī baytin ʾāmin.
dialogue.en: Through marriage life continues and righteous offspring grow up in a safe home.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi se zindagi chalti rehti hai aur nek aulaad ek mehfooz ghar mein parwaan chadhti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِنْسانُ لا يَسْتَغْني عَنْ شَريكٍ يَسْكُنُ إِلَيْهِ، وَقَدْ فُرِضَتْ لِهٰذِهِ العَلاقَةِ حُقوقٌ وَواجِباتٌ عَلَى الطَّرَفَيْنِ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa l-insānu lā yastaghnī ʿan sharīkin yaskunu ilayh, wa qad furiḍat li-hādhihi l-ʿalāqati ḥuqūqun wa wājibātun ʿalā ṭ-ṭarafayni jamīʿn.
dialogue.en: A person cannot do without a partner to find rest in, and rights and duties have been laid down for this relationship on both sides.
dialogue.ur: Insaan aise saathi ke baghair nahi reh sakta jis se sukoon paye, aur is rishte ke liye dono taraf huqooq aur farayez muqarrar kiye gaye hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالإِسْلامُ يَسْمو بِالزَّواجِ فَيَجْعَلُهُ سَكَناً وَمَوَدَّةً، لا مُجَرَّدَ غَريزَةٍ حَيَوانِيَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa l-islāmu yasmū bi-z-zawāji fa-yajʿaluhu sakann wa mawaddatan, lā mujarrada gharīzatin ḥayawāniyyat.
dialogue.en: Islam raises marriage, making it a place of rest and affection, not a mere animal instinct.
dialogue.ur: Islam shaadi ko buland karta hai aur use sukoon aur mohabbat banata hai, mehaz haiwani jibillat nahi.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً﴾
dialogue.tr: «wa min ʾāītihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azūjn li-taskunū ilayhā wa jaʿala baynakum mawaddatan wa raḥmatan»
dialogue.en: «And among His signs is that He created for you spouses from yourselves so that you may find rest in them, and He placed between you affection and mercy.» (Quran)
dialogue.ur: «Aur uski nishaniyon mein se hai ke usne tumhare liye tumhi mein se jode banaye taake tum unse sukoon pao, aur tumhare darmiyan mohabbat aur rahmat rakhi.» (Quran)

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ يَتَفَكَّرُ الخاطِبُ طَويلاً وَيَسْأَلُ عَنْ أَخْلاقِ مَنْ يَتَقَدَّمُ إِلَيْها؛ فَالعُثورُ عَلَى الشَّريكِ الصّالِحِ يَحْتاجُ إِلى صَبْرٍ وَاسْتِشارَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad yatafakkaru l-khāṭibu ṭawīln wa yasʾalu ʿan akhlāqi man yataqaddamu ilayhā; fa-l-ʿuthūru ʿalā sh-sharīki ṣ-ṣāliḥi yaḥtāju ilā ṣabrin wa stishārat.
dialogue.en: The suitor may think for a long time and ask about the character of the one he approaches; finding the righteous partner needs patience and consultation.
dialogue.ur: Rishta bhejne wala der tak sochta aur us ke akhlaq ke baare mein poochta hai; achha saathi dhoondhne ke liye sabr aur mashware ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ مِنَ الحِكْمَةِ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى المالِ وَحْدَهُ أَوِ الجَمالِ وَحْدَهُ، فَقَدْ يَكونانِ فِتْنَةً إِذا غابَ الخُلُق.
dialogue.tr: wa laysa mina l-ḥikmati an yanẓura ilā l-māli waḥdahu awi l-jamāli waḥdah, fa-qad yakūnāni fitnatan idhā ghāba l-khuluq.
dialogue.en: It is not wise to look at wealth alone or beauty alone, for they can become a temptation when good character is absent.
dialogue.ur: Sirf maal ya sirf husn ko dekhna daanai nahi, kyunke jab akhlaq na ho to yeh dono fitna ban sakte hain.

dialogue.ar: «تُنْكَحُ المَرْأَةُ لِأَرْبَعٍ: لِمالِها وَلِحَسَبِها وَلِجَمالِها وَلِدينِها، فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ الدّينِ، تَرِبَتْ يَداكَ».
dialogue.tr: «tunkaḥu l-marʾatu li-arbaʿ: li-mālihā wa liḥasabihā wa lijamālihā wa lidīnihā, fa-ẓfar bi-dhāti d-dīn, taribat yadāk.»
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: a woman is married for four things: her wealth, her family standing, her beauty and her religion; so win the one with religion.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: aurat se chaar wajoohat ki bina par nikaah kiya jata hai: uske maal, khandaan, husn aur deen ki wajah se; tum deendar ko hasil karo.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ تَعالى في شَأْنِ الأَزْواجِ: ﴿وَعَاشِرُوهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: wa qāla taʿālā fī shaʾni l-azūj: «wa ʿāshirūhunna bi-l-maʿrūf.»
dialogue.en: And He said, about spouses: «Live with them in kindness.»
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah ne biwiyon ke baare mein farmaya: «Un ke saath bhalai se zindagi guzaro.»

dialogue.ar: فَالزَّوْجَةُ الصّالِحَةُ تَجْعَلُ البَيْتَ هادِئاً، وَيَأْمَنُ الزَّوْجُ عِنْدَها عَلى بَيْتِهِ وَأَوْلادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-z-zawjatu ṣ-ṣāliḥatu tajʿalu l-bayta hādiʾn, wa yaʾmanu z-zawju ʿindahā ʿalā baytihi wa awlādih.
dialogue.en: The righteous wife makes the house calm, and the husband feels safe with her about his home and children.
dialogue.ur: Nek biwi ghar ko pur-sukoon bana deti hai, aur shauhar apne ghar aur bachon ke baare mein us ke paas mutmain rehta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِأَنَّ الزَّواجَ يَحْتاجُ إِلَى الِاتِّفاقِ بَيْنَ الطَّرَفَيْنِ، فَعَلَى الأَهْلِ أَنْ يَسْمَعوا رَأْيَ الفَتاةِ وَلا يَفْرِضوا عَلَيْها شَيْئاً.
dialogue.tr: wa liʾanna z-zawāja yaḥtāju ilā l-ttifāqi bayna ṭ-ṭarafayn, fa-ʿalā l-ahli an yasmaʿū raʾya l-fatāti wa lā yafriḍū ʿalayhā shayʾn.
dialogue.en: Because marriage needs agreement between the two sides, the family should hear the girl's opinion and not impose anything on her.
dialogue.ur: Chunke shaadi ke liye dono taraf ka ittifaq zaroori hai, ghar walon ko ladki ki raay sunni chahiye aur us par kuch thopna nahi chahiye.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا جاءَ الخاطِبُ إِلى بَيْتِ الفَتاةِ فَلَهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَيْها نَظْرَةً مُحْتَشِمَةً بِعِلْمِ أَهْلِها.
dialogue.tr: wa idhā jāʾa l-khāṭibu ilā bayti l-fatāti fa-lahu an yanẓura ilayhā naẓratan muḥtashimatan bi-ʿilmi ahlihā.
dialogue.en: When the suitor comes to the girl's house he may look at her modestly, with her family's knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Jab rishta lene wala ladki ke ghar aaye to woh ladki ke ghar walon ki maloomat mein haya ke saath use dekh sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهٰكَذا فَمَنْ أَتى بِنِيَّةٍ صادِقَةٍ، وَاخْتارَ صاحِبَةَ الدّينِ وَالخُلُقِ، فَقَدْ بَدَأَ بَيْتَهُ عَلى أَساسٍ مَتين.
dialogue.tr: wa hākadhā fa-man atā bi-niyyatin ṣādiqat, wa khtāra ṣāḥibata d-dīni wa l-khuluq, fa-qad badaʾa baytahu ʿalā asāsin matīn.
dialogue.en: So whoever comes with a sincere intention and chooses a woman of religion and character has begun his home on a firm foundation.
dialogue.ur: Isi tarah jo sachchi niyyat se aaye aur deen aur akhlaq wali ko chune us ne apne ghar ki bunyad mazboot buniyad par rakhi.

title.en: Grammar A: The Work of the Masdar

intro.en: A verbal noun (masdar) can work like a verb: it can take an object. Example: صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ (your doing good is an honour for you) = أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ. The object (المَعْروفَ) stays in the accusative. A masdar can also be replaced by «أَنْ + verb» or «ما + verb».
intro.ur: Masdar kabhi fe'l ki tarah kaam karta hai aur maf'ool ko nasb deta hai. Misaal: صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ (tera neki karna tere liye izzat hai) = أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ. Masdar ki jagah «أَنْ + fe'l» ya «ما + fe'l» bhi aa sakta hai.
intro.ar: يَعْمَلُ المَصْدَرُ عَمَلَ فِعْلِهِ فَيَنْصِبُ مَفْعولاً بِهِ. مِثالٌ: «صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ» أَيْ أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ، وَيَبْقى المَفْعولُ (المَعْروفَ) مَنْصوباً. وَيُمْكِنُ تَأْويلُ المَصْدَرِ بِـ«أَنْ» وَالفِعْلِ أَوْ بِـ«ما» وَالفِعْلِ.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ تَزورَ المَريضَ عَمَلٌ كَريمٌ.
dialogue.tr: an tazūra l-marīḍa ʿamalun karīm.
dialogue.en: That you visit the sick is a noble deed.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mareez ki iyadat karna ek shareef amal hai.

dialogue.ar: زِيارَتُكَ المَريضَ عَمَلٌ كَريمٌ.
dialogue.tr: ziīratuka l-marīḍa ʿamalun karīm.
dialogue.en: Your visiting the sick is a noble deed.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mareez ko dekhne jana ek shareef amal hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ تَحْتَرِمَ الضَّيْفَ دَليلُ كَرَمٍ.
dialogue.tr: an taḥtarima ḍ-ḍayfa dalīlu karam.
dialogue.en: That you respect the guest is a sign of generosity.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mehman ka ehtiram karna sakhawat ki nishani hai.

dialogue.ar: احْتِرامُكَ الضَّيْفَ دَليلُ كَرَمٍ.
dialogue.tr: ḥtirāmuka ḍ-ḍayfa dalīlu karam.
dialogue.en: Your respecting the guest is a sign of generosity.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka mehman ka ehtiram sakhawat ki nishani hai.

dialogue.ar: يَسُرُّني أَنْ تُطْعِمَ المَساكينَ.
dialogue.tr: yasurrunī an tuṭʿima l-masākīn.
dialogue.en: It pleases me that you feed the needy.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe khushi hoti hai ke aap miskeenon ko khana khilate hain.

dialogue.ar: يَسُرُّني إِطْعامُكَ المَساكينَ.
dialogue.tr: yasurrunī iṭʿāmuka l-masākīn.
dialogue.en: Your feeding the needy pleases me.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka miskeenon ko khana khilana mujhe khush karta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَعْجَبَني عَطاؤُكَ الفُقَراءَ بِلا مِنَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: aʿjabanī ʿaṭāʾuka l-fuqarāʾa bilā minnat.
dialogue.en: Your giving to the poor without reproach impressed me.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka gareebon ko ehsan jatay baghair dena mujhe bhaya.

dialogue.ar: صِلَتُكَ الأَرْحامَ سَبَبٌ لِلْمَحَبَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: ṣilatuka l-arḥāma sababun li-l-maḥabbat.
dialogue.en: Your keeping ties with relatives is a cause of love.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka rishtedaron se jurna mohabbat ka sabab hai.

dialogue.ar: حُبُّكَ الوَطَنَ يَدْفَعُكَ إِلى خِدْمَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥubbuka l-waṭana yadfaʿuka ilā khidmatih.
dialogue.en: Your love of the homeland pushes you to serve it.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka watan se pyar aap ko us ki khidmat par ubharta hai.

dialogue.ar: إِكْراماً الضَّيْفَ!
dialogue.tr: ikrāmn ḍ-ḍayf!
dialogue.en: Honouring the guest!
dialogue.ur: Mehman ki izzat karo!

dialogue.ar: تَرْكُكَ العَبَثَ في الدَّرْسِ دَليلُ نُضْجٍ.
dialogue.tr: tarkuka l-ʿabatha fī d-darsi dalīlu nuḍj.
dialogue.en: Your leaving play in the lesson is a sign of maturity.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka sabaq mein shararat chhorna samajhdari ki nishani hai.

dialogue.ar: اِسْتِشارَتُكَ الأَطِبّاءَ في مَرَضِكَ مِنَ الحِكْمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: istishāratuka l-aṭibbāʾa fī maraḍika mina l-ḥikmat.
dialogue.en: Your consulting doctors about your illness is part of wisdom.
dialogue.ur: Aap ka apni bimari mein doctoron se mashwara karna hikmat hai.

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (1): Ajeeb shaadi ki raat

intro.en: Here is the story of the judge Hamid and his wife Salma, in three short statements. Read them, then answer the true/false and multiple-choice questions. The slides give the questions.
intro.ur: Yeh qazi Hamid aur unki biwi Salma ki kahani hai, teen mukhtasar jumlon mein. Inhein parhein phir sahih-ghalat aur multiple-choice sawalat ke jawab dein. Slides mein sawalat hain.
intro.ar: هٰذِهِ قِصَّةُ القاضي حامِدٍ وَزَوْجَتِهِ سَلْمى في ثَلاثِ جُمَلٍ قَصيرَةٍ. اقْرَأْها ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالِاخْتِيارِ مِنْ مُتَعَدِّدٍ. تَعْرِضُ الشَّرائِحُ الأَسْئِلَةَ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ حامِدٌ قاضِياً مَشْهوراً في مَدينَتِهِ، يَقْضي بَيْنَ النّاسِ بِالعَدْل.
dialogue.tr: kāna ḥāmidun qāḍiīn mashhūrn fī madīnatih, yaqḍī bayna n-nāsi bi-l-ʿadl.
dialogue.en: Hamid was a famous judge in his city, judging between people with justice.
dialogue.ur: Hamid apne shehar ka mashhoor qazi tha, jo logon ke darmiyan insaaf se faisla karta tha.

dialogue.ar: مَكَثَتْ سَلْمى مَعَ زَوْجِها حامِدٍ ثَلاثينَ عاماً، وَلَمْ يَغْضَبْ مِنْها يَوْماً واحِداً.
dialogue.tr: makathat salmā maʿa zawjihā ḥāmidin thalāthīna ʿāmn, wa lam yaghḍab minhā yawmn wāḥidn.
dialogue.en: Salma stayed with her husband Hamid for thirty years, and he was not angry with her for a single day.
dialogue.ur: Salma apne shauhar Hamid ke saath tees saal rahi, aur woh ek din bhi us se naraaz nahi hua.

dialogue.ar: في لَيْلَةِ الزِّفافِ صَلّى حامِدٌ وَسَلْمى رَكْعَتَيْنِ شُكْراً لِلَّهِ، ثُمَّ تَحَدَّثا عَنْ جَمالِ الخُلُقِ في البَيْت.
dialogue.tr: fī laylati z-zifāfi ṣallā ḥāmidun wa salmā rakʿatayni shukrn llāh, thumma taḥaddathā ʿan jamāli l-khuluqi fī l-bayt.
dialogue.en: On the wedding night Hamid and Salma prayed two rak'ahs in thanks to Allah, then talked about the beauty of good character in the home.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi ki raat Hamid aur Salma ne Allah ka shukr ada karte hue do rakat namaz parhi, phir ghar mein achhe akhlaq ki khoobsurti par baat ki.

q.en: Who was Hamid?
How long did Salma stay with her husband (in the questions)?
q.ur: Salma apne shauhar ke saath kitni muddat rahi (sawalat ke mutabiq)?
q.ar: كَمْ مَكَثَتْ سَلْمى مَعَ زَوْجِها (في الأَسْئِلَةِ)؟

q.en: What does «عُرْس» mean?
What did Hamid and Salma do in thanks to Allah?
q.ur: Hamid aur Salma ne Allah ka shukr ada karne ke liye kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ حامِدٌ وَسَلْمى شُكْراً لِلَّهِ؟

intro.en: The story of the student Yusuf and his teacher Sheikh Ibrahim, who married his daughter to him for a small dowry. Then a speaking exercise: discuss modern topics with a classmate.
intro.ur: Talib-e-ilm Yusuf aur unke ustaad Sheikh Ibrahim ki kahani, jinhon ne thore se mehar par apni beti ka nikah un se kar diya. Phir bolne ki mashq: apne sathi ke saath jadeed mauzoat par baat karein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةُ التِّلْميذِ يوسُفَ وَشَيْخِهِ إِبْراهيمَ الَّذي زَوَّجَهُ ابْنَتَهُ بِمَهْرٍ يَسيرٍ. ثُمَّ تَمْرينٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: تُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلِكَ مَوْضوعاتٍ مُعاصِرَةً.

dialogue.ar: كانَ يوسُفُ يُلازِمُ المَسْجِدَ الكَبيرَ في مَدينَتِهِ لِيَتَعَلَّمَ.
dialogue.tr: kāna yūsufu yulāzimu l-masjida l-kabīra fī madīnatihi li-yataʿallam.
dialogue.en: Yusuf used to stay constantly in the great mosque of his city in order to learn.
dialogue.ur: Yusuf seekhne ke liye apne shehar ki bari masjid mein lagataar rehta tha.

dialogue.ar: كانَ يوسُفُ مِنْ تَلاميذِ الشَّيْخِ إِبْراهيمَ في حَلْقَةِ العِلْمِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna yūsufu min talāmīdhi sh-shaykhi ibrāhīma fī ḥalqati l-ʿilm.
dialogue.en: Yusuf was one of the students of Sheikh Ibrahim in the circle of knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Yusuf Sheikh Ibrahim ke halqa-e-ilm ke shagirdon mein se tha.

dialogue.ar: غابَ يوسُفُ عَنِ الحَلْقَةِ أَيّاماً بَعْدَ وَفاةِ والِدِهِ.
dialogue.tr: ghāba yūsufu ʿani l-ḥalqati ayyāmn baʿda wafāti wālidih.
dialogue.en: Yusuf was absent from the circle for some days after his father's death.
dialogue.ur: Yusuf apne walid ke inteqal ke baad kuch din halqe se gair haazir raha.

dialogue.ar: فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ الشَّيْخُ، وَلَمّا عَرَفَ حالَهُ عَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ ابْنَتَهُ لِما رَأى فيهِ مِنْ خُلُقٍ وَدين.
dialogue.tr: fa-saʾala ʿanhu sh-shaykh, wa lammā ʿarafa ḥālahu ʿaraḍa ʿalayhi an yuzawwijahu bnatahu limā raʾā fīhi min khuluqin wa dīn.
dialogue.en: The sheikh asked about him, and when he knew his situation he offered to marry his daughter to him because of the character and religion he saw in him.
dialogue.ur: Sheikh ne us ke baare mein poocha, aur jab us ka haal jaana to us mein jo akhlaq aur deen dekha us ki wajah se apni beti ka nikah us se karne ki peshkash ki.

dialogue.ar: كانَ المَهْرُ ثَلاثَةَ دَراهِمَ فَقَط، لِأَنَّ الشَّيْخَ يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُيَسِّرَ الزَّواجَ عَلَى الشَّباب.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-mahru thalāthata darāhima faqaṭ, liʾanna sh-shaykha yuḥibbu an yuyassira z-zawāja ʿalā sh-shabāb.
dialogue.en: The dowry was only three dirhams, because the sheikh loves to make marriage easy for young people.
dialogue.ur: Mehar sirf teen dirham tha, kyunke Sheikh chahte the ke naujawanon ke liye shaadi aasaan ho.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ تاجِرٌ غَنِيٌّ قَدْ خَطَبَ الفَتاةَ مِنْ قَبْلُ، فَاعْتَذَرَ الشَّيْخُ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَجِدْ فيهِ ما يُريدُ مِنَ الدّين.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna tājirun ghaniyyun qad khaṭaba l-fatāta min qabl, fa-ʿtadhara sh-shaykhu li-annahu lam yajid fīhi mā yurīdu mina d-dīn.
dialogue.en: A rich merchant had proposed to the girl before, and the sheikh declined because he did not find in him what he wanted of religion.
dialogue.ur: Pehle ek ameer taajir ne bhi ladki ka rishta bheja tha, Sheikh ne inkar kiya kyunke us mein deen ki woh baat nahi payi jo woh chahte the.

dialogue.ar: تَمَّ العَقْدُ في المَسْجِدِ بِحُضورِ الجيرانِ وَالأَصْدِقاء، وَعاشَ يوسُفُ مَعَ زَوْجَتِهِ بِسَعادَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: tamma l-ʿaqdu fī l-masjidi bi-ḥuḍūri l-jīrāni wa l-aṣdiqāʾ, wa ʿāsha yūsufu maʿa zawjatihi bi-saʿādat.
dialogue.en: The contract was completed in the mosque in the presence of neighbours and friends, and Yusuf lived with his wife in happiness.
dialogue.ur: Nikah masjid mein padosiyon aur doston ki maujoodgi mein hua, aur Yusuf apni biwi ke saath khushi se raha.

dialogue.ar: حاوِرْ زَميلَكَ في المَوْضوعاتِ التّالِيَةِ: التَّعَلُّمُ في المَسْجِدِ أَوْ عَبْرَ الشَّبَكَةِ، وَالعَوْلَمَةُ وَأَثَرُها في لُغَتِنا بَيْنَ النِّعْمَةِ وَالنِّقْمَة.
dialogue.tr: ḥāwir zamīlaka fī l-mawḍūʿāti t-tāliyat: at-taʿallumu fī l-masjidi aw ʿabra sh-shabakat, wa l-ʿawlamatu wa atharuhā fī lughatinā bayna n-niʿmati wa n-niqma.
dialogue.en: Discuss with your classmate the following topics: learning in the mosque or over the network, and globalisation and its effect on our language, between blessing and curse.
dialogue.ur: Apne sathi se in mauzoat par baat karein: masjid mein seekhna ya network ke zariye, aur aalmgeeriyat ka hamari zubaan par asar, naimat ya aafat.

q.en: Whose student was Yusuf?
Why did the sheikh marry his daughter to him?
q.ur: Sheikh ne apni beti ka nikah us se kyun kiya?

options: Because he had character and religion

q.en: How much was the dowry in the story?
Where was the marriage contract done?
What does «مَهْر» mean?

options_ar: المالُ الَّذي يَدْفَعُهُ الزَّوْجُ لِزَوْجَتِهِ عِنْدَ الزَّواجِ

intro.en: We can make a verb stronger by adding the emphatic noon (نونُ التَّوْكيد), light (نْ) or heavy (نَّ). Examples: اِقْرَأَنَّ (surely read!), لَنَخْرُجَنَّ (we will surely go out). The emphasis is obligatory, allowed or forbidden depending on the verb's form; for example after an oath it is obligatory for a future verb.
intro.ur: Fe'l ko mazboot karne ke liye nun-e-takeed lagate hain: halka (نْ) ya bhaari (نَّ). Misaal: اِقْرَأَنَّ (zaroor parho!), لَنَخْرُجَنَّ (hum zaroor niklenge). Fe'l ki shakl ke mutabiq takeed wajib, jaiz ya mumtani hoti hai; jaise qasam ke jawab mein mustaqbil ke fe'l par wajib.
intro.ar: نَسْتَطيعُ تَقْوِيَةَ الفِعْلِ بِإِضافَةِ نونِ التَّوْكيدِ خَفيفَةً (نْ) أَوْ ثَقيلَةً (نَّ). أَمْثِلَةٌ: اِقْرَأَنَّ، لَنَخْرُجَنَّ. وَيَكونُ التَّوْكيدُ واجِباً أَوْ جائِزاً أَوْ مُمْتَنِعاً بِحَسَبِ صورَةِ الفِعْلِ؛ فَهُوَ واجِبٌ مَثَلاً في الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ المُسْتَقْبَلِ إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ القَسَمِ.

dialogue.ar: وَاللهِ لَأَجْتَهِدَنَّ في دَرْسي.
dialogue.tr: wa l-lhi laʾajtahidanna fī darsī.
dialogue.en: By Allah, I will surely strive in my lesson.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, main apne sabaq mein zaroor mehnat karunga.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُم﴾
dialogue.tr: «wa tāllhi laʾakīdanna aṣnāmakum»
dialogue.en: By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, main tumhare butoon ke saath zaroor chaal chalunga.

dialogue.ar: ﴿لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ﴾
dialogue.tr: «laʾin ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna maʿakum»
dialogue.en: If you are driven out, we will surely go out with you.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum nikale gaye to hum zaroor tumhare saath niklenge.

dialogue.ar: لا تُهْمِلَنَّ واجِباتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tuhmilanna wājibātik.
dialogue.en: Never neglect your duties.
dialogue.ur: Apne farayez ko hargiz nazar-andaz na karo.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ غَافِلًا﴾
dialogue.tr: «wa lā taḥsabanna llāha ghāfiln»
dialogue.en: And never think that Allah is unaware.
dialogue.ur: Aur hargiz Allah ko ghaafil na samajhna.

dialogue.ar: وَاللهِ لَيَنْجَحَنَّ المُجْتَهِدُ بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa l-lhi layanjaḥanna l-mujtahidu bi-idhni llāh.
dialogue.en: By Allah, the hard-working one will surely succeed, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, mehnat karne wala Allah ke hukm se zaroor kaamyab hoga.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَعْلَمَ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّابِرِينَ﴾
dialogue.tr: «wa lanabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum wa ṣ-ṣābirīna»
dialogue.en: We will surely test you until We know those who strive and are patient among you.
dialogue.ur: Hum zaroor tumhe aazmayenge yahan tak ke hum jaan len tum mein se mujahid aur sabr karne wale kaun hain.

vocab.ur: woh yaad karta / hifazat karta hai

q.en: What is the purpose of the emphatic noon (نونُ التَّوْكيد)?
What does «تَوْكيد» mean?
What does «مُضارِع» mean?

options_ar: فِعْلٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى الحاضِرِ أَوِ المُسْتَقْبَلِ

q.en: What does «واجِب» mean?
Which of these is an emphasised verb?
q.ur: In mein se kaun sa fe'l takeed wala hai?

intro.en: Scene two, in our own words: Abu Bakr, in his last illness, consults the Companions about appointing Umar ibn al-Khattab as the next caliph, dictates the covenant, and the people accept it. Read it with the speakers in mind.
intro.ur: Doosra manzar, hamare apne alfaz mein: Abu Bakr apni aakhri bimari mein sahaba se mashwara karte hain ke Umar bin Khattab ko agla khalifa banayen, ahd likhwate hain, aur log use qubool karte hain. Bolne walon ko zehn mein rakh kar parhein.
intro.ar: المَشْهَدُ الثّاني بِعِبارَتِنا: يَسْتَشيرُ أَبو بَكْرٍ في مَرَضِهِ الأَخيرِ الصَّحابَةَ في اسْتِخْلافِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخَطّابِ، وَيُمْلي العَهْدَ، ثُمَّ يَرْضى النّاسُ بِهِ. اقْرَأْهُ مُراعِياً المُتَكَلِّمينَ.

dialogue.ar: دَعَوْتَنا يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ، فَها نَحْنُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: daʿawtanā yā khalīfata rasūli llāh, fa-hā naḥnu bayna yadayk.
dialogue.en: You called us, successor of the Messenger of Allah, so here we are before you.
dialogue.ur: Aap ne humein bulaya, Khalifa-e-Rasoolullah, to hum haazir hain.

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً بِكَ يا عُثْمانُ، اجْلِسْ؛ فَإِنّي أُريدُ أَنْ أَسْتَرْشِدَ بِرَأْيِكَ في أَمْرٍ يَخُصُّ المُهاجِرينَ وَالأَنْصارَ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: ahln bika yā ʿuthmān, jlis; fa-innī urīdu an astarshida bi-raʾyika fī amrin yakhuṣṣu l-muhājirīna wa l-anṣāra jamīʿn.
dialogue.en: Welcome, Uthman, sit; I want to seek guidance from your opinion in a matter concerning all the Muhajirun and Ansar.
dialogue.ur: Khush-amdeed Usman, baithiye; main ek aise maamle mein aap ki raay se rehnumai chahta hoon jo tamam Muhajirin aur Ansar se talluq rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفَ بَعْدي رَجُلاً قَوِيّاً أَميناً، وَقَدِ اسْتَشَرْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ قَبْلَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an astakhlifa baʿdī rajuln qawiyyn amīnn, wa qadi stashartu ʿabda r-raḥmāni bna ʿawfin qablakum.
dialogue.en: I want to appoint after me a strong, trustworthy man, and I consulted 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn 'Awf before you.
dialogue.ur: Main chahta hoon ke apne baad ek taqatwar ameen shakhs ko jaanasheen banaon, aur aap se pehle Abdur Rahman bin Auf se mashwara kar chuka hoon.

dialogue.ar: فَما رَأْيُكَ أَنْتَ في عُمَرَ بْنِ الخَطّابِ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-mā raʾyuka anta fī ʿumara bni l-khaṭṭāb?
dialogue.en: So what is your opinion of 'Umar ibn al-Khattab?
dialogue.ur: To Umar bin Khattab ke baare mein aap ki kya raay hai?

dialogue.ar: هُوَ أَقْوانا في الحَقِّ، وَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّ سَريرَتَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَلانِيَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: huwa aqūnā fī l-ḥaqq, wa aʿlamu anna sarīratahu khayrun min ʿalāniyatih.
dialogue.en: He is the strongest of us in the truth, and I know that his inner self is better than his outward one.
dialogue.ur: Woh haq mein hum sab se zyada mazboot hain, aur main jaanta hoon ke un ka baatin un ke zahir se behtar hai.

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَقولُ لِرَبِّكَ إِذا سَأَلَكَ عَنِ اسْتِخْلافِ عُمَرَ، وَقَدْ تَرى شِدَّتَهُ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taqūlu li-rabbika idhā saʾalaka ʿani stikhlāfi ʿumar, wa qad tarā shiddatah?
dialogue.en: What will you say to your Lord if He asks you about appointing 'Umar, while you see his sternness?
dialogue.ur: Agar aap ka Rab Umar ko khalifa banane ke baare mein poochhe to aap kya kahenge, jab ke aap un ki sakhti dekhte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَبِرَبّي تُخَوِّفُني؟ أَقولُ: يا رَبِّ، اسْتَخْلَفْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ خَيْرَ أَهْلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: abirabbī tukhawwifunī? aqūl: yā rabb, stakhlaftu ʿalayhim khayra ahlik.
dialogue.en: Are you frightening me with my Lord? I will say: O Lord, I appointed over them the best of Your people.
dialogue.ur: Kya aap mujhe mere Rab se dara rahe hain? Main kahunga: ae mere Rab, maine un par aap ke logon mein se behtareen shakhs ko khalifa banaya.

dialogue.ar: سَمْعاً وَطاعَةً يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ، فَما أَرَدْتَ إِلّا الخَيْرَ لِلْأُمَّة.
dialogue.tr: samʿn wa ṭāʿatan yā khalīfata rasūli llāh, fa-mā aradta illā l-khayra li-l-umma.
dialogue.en: We hear and obey, successor of the Messenger of Allah; you wanted only good for the nation.
dialogue.ur: Hum ne suna aur maana Khalifa-e-Rasoolullah; aap ne ummat ke liye sirf bhalai chahi.

dialogue.ar: تَناوَلْ هٰذا القِرْطاسَ يا عُثْمانُ وَاكْتُبْ ما أُمْليهِ عَلَيْكَ؛ فَهٰذا عَهْدٌ لِلْمُسْلِمين.
dialogue.tr: tanāwal hādhā l-qirṭāsa yā ʿuthmānu wa ktub mā umlīhi ʿalayk; fa-hādhā ʿahdun li-l-muslimīn.
dialogue.en: Take this paper, Uthman, and write what I dictate to you; this is a covenant for the Muslims.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kaghaz lijiye Usman aur jo main likhwata hoon likhiye; yeh musalmanon ke liye ek ahd hai.

dialogue.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ. هٰذا عَهْدٌ أَكْتُبُهُ وَأَنا عَلى أَبْوابِ الآخِرَةِ، وَهِيَ ساعَةٌ يُصَدِّقُ فيها الكافِرُ وَيَتَّقي فيها الفاجِرُ.
dialogue.tr: bismi llāhi r-raḥmāni r-raḥīm. hādhā ʿahdun aktubuhu wa anā ʿalā abūbi l-ʾākhirat, wa hiya sāʿatun yuṣaddiqu fīhā l-kāfiru wa yattaqī fīhā l-fājir.
dialogue.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. This is a covenant I write while at the gates of the Hereafter, an hour in which the unbeliever believes and the wicked person fears Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah ke naam se jo bara meherbaan nihayat raham karne wala hai. Yeh ahd main aakhirat ke darwazon par likhwa raha hoon, woh ghadi jab kafir bhi tasdeeq karta hai aur faajir bhi darta hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنّي جَعَلْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الخَطّابِ خَليفَةً عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدي، فَاسْمَعوا لَهُ وَأَطيعوا.
dialogue.tr: innī jaʿaltu ʿumara bna l-khaṭṭābi khalīfatan ʿalaykum baʿdī, fa-smaʿū lahu wa aṭīʿū.
dialogue.en: I have made Umar ibn al-Khattab caliph over you after me, so listen to him and obey.
dialogue.ur: Maine Umar bin Khattab ko apne baad aap par khalifa banaya hai, to un ki suno aur maano.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَصابَتْني غَشْيَةٌ قَبْلَ قَليلٍ، فَخِفْتُ أَنْ أَموتَ فَيَخْتَلِفَ النّاسُ مِنْ بَعْدي.
dialogue.tr: wa qad aṣābatnī ghashyatun qabla qalīl, fa-khiftu an amūta fa-yakhtalifa n-nāsu min baʿdī.
dialogue.en: A faint came over me a little while ago, so I feared I would die and the people would differ after me.
dialogue.ur: Thori der pehle mujh par behoshi tari hui, to mujhe dar hua ke main mar jaoon aur log mere baad ikhtilaf karein.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً يا أَبا بَكْرٍ؛ لَقَدْ كَتَبْتُ العَهْدَ كَما أَمْلَيْتَ.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayrn yā abā bakr; laqad katabtu l-ʿahda kamā amlayt.
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you well, Abu Bakr; I have written the covenant as you dictated.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko jaza-e-khair de Abu Bakr; maine ahd waisa hi likh diya jaisa aap ne likhwaya.

dialogue.ar: يا أَبي، لَقَدِ اجْتَمَعَ النّاسُ خارِجَ البَيْتِ يَنْتَظِرونَ.
dialogue.tr: yā abī, laqadi jtamaʿa n-nāsu khārija l-bayti yantaẓirūn.
dialogue.en: Father, the people have gathered outside the house waiting.
dialogue.ur: Abba jaan, log ghar ke bahar jama ho kar intezar kar rahe hain.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَباً يا ابْنَتي يا أُمَّ المُؤْمِنينَ، أَعينوني عَلَى الخُروجِ إِلَيْهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: marḥabn yā bnatī yā umma l-muʾminīn, aʿīnūnī ʿalā l-khurūji ilayhim.
dialogue.en: Welcome, my daughter, Mother of the Believers; help me to go out to them.
dialogue.ur: Khush-amdeed meri beti, Ummul Momineen; mujhe un ke paas jaane mein sahara dijiye.

dialogue.ar: يا مَعْشَرَ المُسْلِمينَ، أَصْغَوْا إِلى كَلامي، فَقَدْ لا أَلْقاكُمْ بَعْدَ هٰذا اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: yā maʿshara l-muslimīn, aṣghawā ilā kalāmī, fa-qad lā alqākum baʿda hādhā l-yawm.
dialogue.en: O community of Muslims, listen to my words, for I may not meet you after this day.
dialogue.ur: Ae musalmanon ki jamaat, meri baat suno, kyunke shayad main is din ke baad tum se na mil sakoon.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَرْضَوْنَ بِمَنِ اخْتَرْتُهُ لَكُمْ؟ فَإِنَّني ما اخْتَرْتُ إِلّا خَيْراً لَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: hal tarḍawna bimani khtartuhu lakum? fa-innanī mā khtartu illā khayrn lakum.
dialogue.en: Are you pleased with the one I chose for you? I chose only what is good for you.
dialogue.ur: Kya aap us se raazi hain jise maine aap ke liye chuna? Maine sirf aap ki bhalai chuni hai.

dialogue.ar: رَضينا بِاخْتِيارِكَ، وَلَنْ نَسْخَطَ عَلى مَنْ تُوَلّيهِ أَمْرَنا.
dialogue.tr: raḍīnā bi-khtiīrik, wa lan naskhaṭa ʿalā man tuwallīhi amranā.
dialogue.en: We are pleased with your choice, and we will not be angry with the one you put in charge of our affairs.
dialogue.ur: Hum aap ke intikhaab se raazi hain, aur jise aap hamara zimmedaar banayenge us se hum naraaz nahi honge.

q.en: Whom did Abu Bakr choose to succeed him?
q.ur: Abu Bakr ne apna jaanasheen kise chuna?

q.en: What qualities did Abu Bakr want in the successor?
q.ur: Abu Bakr jaanasheen mein kaunsi sifaat chahte the?
q.ar: ما الصِّفاتُ الَّتي أَرادَها أَبو بَكْرٍ في الخَليفَةِ؟

q.en: Who wrote down the covenant?
What did the people answer in the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein logon ne kya jawab diya?

options: They were pleased with his choice

q.en: What does «خَليفَة» mean?

options_ar: مَنْ يَحُلُّ مَحَلَّ غَيْرِهِ في الحُكْمِ
